ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity dark grey/black base covering approximately 80% of the area with high-intensity white pixel clusters and lines covering the remaining 20%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast irregular white patches concentrated on the upper-mid section of the left lobe; multiple high-intensity circular ring structures (rosettes) distributed across the lower-mid sections of both lobes; dense white linear streaks scattered non-uniformly.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central notch with an approximate 50-degree interior angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (jagged peaks and valleys) visible across the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased irregularity near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric concave curvature along the superior margins of both lobes, tapering to acute points at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of white circular rings (barnacle scars); primary constellation of 5-7 rings on the lower-left lobe and approximately 4-6 scattered rings on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing at various angles, most prominent on the left lobe and lower central region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical barnacle colonies (protruding white/tan calcified clusters) visible along the outer distal edges and tips of both lobes; extensive coverage of rake marks and circular scarring across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Substantial leading-edge barnacle encrustation providing a highly irregular, textured 3D profile to the outer fluke margins.
